Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We don't ship internationally at this time — online orders are only available within the United States and Canada. Since international shipping is not offered, customs and duties do not apply to our orders.

If you're located outside the US or Canada, you can check our store locator to see if there are retail options in your area that carry Open Farm products.
